name: @pipeworx/mcp-pub-dev

tools.name: get_package
tools.description: Get metadata for a Dart/Flutter package on pub.dev: latest version, description, homepage, repository, supported SDK environment, and publish date (from the pubspec).

tools.name: get_package_score
tools.description: Get the pub.dev quality score for a Dart/Flutter package: granted/max pub points, like count, popularity, 30-day download count, and classification tags (platforms, SDKs, license).

tools.name: search_packages
tools.description: Search pub.dev for Dart & Flutter packages by keyword. Returns matching package names and a next-page URL.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "state management" or "http client".

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List all published versions of a Dart/Flutter package on pub.dev, with each version string and its publish date, plus the current latest version.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-pub-dev forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the pub-dev pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
